# Native and private-driver stream supplement

Source-only expectations for independent review before native/driver execution.
The parent source/model freeze and its semantic outcomes remain unchanged.

expectations.json freezes32 default descriptors (22 ELF runs, including10
overflow failures, and10 admission-only failures),18 selected fuel runs,
12 driver fixtures ×3 operations ×2 formats, and regular/symlink no-clobber
streams for scalar and owned pilots. Each profile has its own actual receipts.
Actual compile success for a program with runtime overflow remains distinct
from its executable's expected exit1.

build.py reads the frozen expected schedules and source bytes. The renderer
implements the established plain human and JSON diagnostic/summary contract.
It uses independent UTF-8 byte origins and Unicode scalar columns. Expected
messages/secondary labels come from the corrected Unit2 source contract bound
by source-provenance.json. No candidate output is read, and no Rust/Oxid/LLVM
program is invoked.

Only literal `${FIXTURE_ROOT}` and `${OUTPUT}` substitution is permitted, with
paths chosen from the invocation before reading output. FIXTURE_ROOT is the
qualifier's cloned fixture directory, originally specified as
`/workspace/scratch/8266abf56995/typed-project-unit3-native-driver-review/fixtures`.
It is not inferred from a diagnostic. JSON strings use the substituted path as
an ordinary string value; no result-dependent rewriting is allowed.

The finalized18 fuel cases replace the preparer's proposed roster before any
execution. Original proposed files remain preserved. The chosen cyclic sources
exercise first WriteField, nested dispatch→commit Invoke, normal borrowed-call
return, lexical StorageEnd, continue cleanup, break cleanup, final one-below,
and exact-budget success. The numeric budgets are in fuel-request-roster.json
and source-only fuel-requests.jsonl. Denied-operation names, costs, exact origins
and paid prefixes are frozen separately in expectations.json.

The fuel requests retain the parent source_root spelling. A source-only runner
must resolve it against the original oracle package (or materialize that exact
source manifest into its approved fixture clone); it must not interpret the
supplement directory as the source-root owner or change source bytes.

This supplement is about exact outcomes/formatting and boundary selection. It
does not itself prove native execution, physical stores, tool invocation order,
driver reuse, source unavailability, no-clobber behavior, or either compiler
profile. Those require separate actual receipts and comparison.
